reaction_model.honest_conclusion: No candidate form beats a flat 'predict the mean' baseline on held-out data (val r2 is negative for all three forms; test r2 is also negative for the selected form). The pooled, whole-sample correlation reported earlier (rho=0.119) is real as a population-level statistic -- it is not a measurement artifact -- but it is not stable enough across time/companies to support a model fit on one slice of the data predicting another. The honest equation below is reported for completeness and as the input to the pair-trade sketch, not as a validated predictive tool.
reaction_model.category_check_conclusion: Category slopes differ enough to warrant reporting separately, but see n per category before trusting this.

permutation_test.interpretation: Fraction of random (sign-shuffled) strategies with LOWER mean P&L than the real one. Close to 1.0 means the real strategy's edge is unlikely to be chance; close to 0.5 means it is indistinguishable from randomly guessing direction.

not_modeled: Polymarket bid-ask spread and taker fees, which could easily exceed a signal this small on a per-trade basis
Capital requirements / position sizing beyond a simple magnitude weight

Whether the real stock's move is actually observable before Polymarket's contract price updates -- GDELT's day-precision timestamps cannot confirm lead-lag ordering at sub-day resolution, so this strategy's core timing assumption is plausible but unverified with the data available here
